name: Lineal Matter Intelligence
description: Lineal eDiscovery matter analytics (AmplifyAI Command Center style): every document batch processed and reviewed across Lineal client matters, with volumes, culling, review throughput, privilege SLA, QC and cost by matter, client, region, data source, AmplifyAI module and review method. Daily from Oct 2024 to Oct 2026.

columns.name: Batch ID
columns.desc: Unique document batch moving through the Lineal review workflow.

columns.name: Batch Date
columns.desc: Date the batch was loaded and processed.

columns.name: Region
columns.desc: Jurisdiction region of the matter.

columns.name: Country
columns.desc: Country of the matter.

columns.name: Client Industry
columns.desc: Industry of the client.

columns.name: Client
columns.desc: Client account (corporate legal department or law firm).

columns.name: Matter Type
columns.desc: Type of legal matter.

columns.name: Matter
columns.desc: Matter (case) name.

columns.name: Matter ID
columns.desc: Lineal matter number.

columns.name: Review Language
columns.desc: Primary review language of the matter.

columns.name: Review Team
columns.desc: Managed review team working the matter.

columns.name: Pricing Model
columns.desc: Commercial pricing model on the matter.

columns.name: Custodian Role
columns.desc: Business role of the custodian whose data was collected.

columns.name: Custodian
columns.desc: Custodian whose data is in the batch.

columns.name: Data Source
columns.desc: System the documents were collected from.

columns.name: Source Group
columns.desc: Data source family: Email, Chat & Mobile, Files & Structured.

columns.name: AmplifyAI Module
columns.desc: AmplifyAI module applied to the batch before review.

columns.name: Review Method
columns.desc: Review approach used: aiR assisted, TAR/CAL, hybrid or linear.

columns.name: Docs Collected
columns.desc: Documents collected and processed in the batch.

columns.name: Data Volume (GB)
columns.desc: Gigabytes processed.

columns.name: Docs Promoted to Review
columns.desc: Documents left after culling, dedupe and AmplifyAI suppression.

columns.name: Docs Reviewed
columns.desc: Documents reviewed by human reviewers.

columns.name: Responsive Docs
columns.desc: Documents coded responsive.

columns.name: Privileged Docs
columns.desc: Documents flagged privileged.

columns.name: Docs Produced
columns.desc: Documents produced to the requesting party.

columns.name: Review Hours
columns.desc: Reviewer hours spent on the batch.

columns.name: Privilege Turnaround Hours
columns.desc: Hours from privilege flag to privilege decision.

columns.name: Privilege Batches
columns.desc: Batches that needed privilege review.

columns.name: Privilege SLA Met Batches
columns.desc: Privilege batches decided within the 72-hour SLA.

columns.name: QC Sampled Docs
columns.desc: Reviewed documents sampled for quality control.

columns.name: QC Overturns
columns.desc: Sampled documents whose coding QC overturned.

columns.name: Processing Cost
columns.desc: Processing and hosting cost.

columns.name: Review Cost
columns.desc: Managed review labour cost.

columns.name: Technology Cost
columns.desc: AmplifyAI and aiR technology cost.

columns.name: Total Cost
columns.desc: Total matter cost for the batch.

columns.name: Budget
columns.desc: Budget allocated to the batch.

columns.name: Chat Docs Collected
columns.desc: Documents collected from Teams, Slack and WhatsApp / mobile.

columns.name: Workflow ID
columns.desc: Workflow ticket for the batch.

columns.name: Workflow Stage
columns.desc: Current stage of the batch in the review workflow.

columns.name: Days in Stage
columns.desc: Days the open batch has sat in its current stage.

columns.name: Batches
columns.desc: Number of batches.

formulas.name: Cull Rate
formulas.desc: Share of collected documents removed before review (culling, dedupe, AmplifyAI suppression).

formulas.name: Chat Data Share
formulas.desc: Share of collected documents that came from Teams, Slack and WhatsApp / mobile.

formulas.name: Privilege SLA Hit Rate
formulas.desc: Share of privilege batches decided within the 72-hour SLA.

formulas.name: QC Overturn Rate
formulas.desc: Share of QC-sampled documents whose coding was overturned.

formulas.name: Budget Variance %
formulas.desc: Total cost over budget, as a share of budget.
